action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Juthawong Naisanguansee discovered that NetworkManager on Ubuntu
incorrectly granted the whoopsie user unrestricted D-Bus access to
root-only methods. A local attacker who can execute code as the whoopsie
user could possibly use this issue to disrupt system networking or alter
NetworkManager logging and connection configurations.
isummary: NetworkManager could allow unintended changes to network configuration.
title: NetworkManager vulnerability
